info.title: Facilito API
info.description:
The Facilito API lets you manage your business catalog, customers, staff, locations, inventory, and sales. It is organized around REST, accepts JSON request bodies, and returns JSON responses with standard HTTP methods and status codes.

Send a bearer access token in the Authorization header with each request. Your authenticated account identifies the merchant whose data you can access and the permissions available to you.

List operations return one page at a time. Omit `cursor` for the first page, then pass the response's `next_cursor` as `cursor` while `has_more` is true. Keep any filters unchanged between pages.

Error responses include a stable `code`, a human-readable `message`, and a `request_id`. Use `code` for error handling and retain `request_id` when investigating a failed request. POST operations accept an optional `Idempotency-Key` header for safe retries. See the header description for retry requirements and expiry.

post.description: Signs a Pusher subscription to private-{merchantId} for the authenticated account. The merchant and enabled owner or staff membership are resolved from the database. Only an exact match with the current merchant channel is allowed. Send socket_id and channel_name as form fields. The response can be passed directly to Pusher.

400.description: The socket ID or channel name is missing or invalid. Returns validation_error.

401.description: A valid bearer access token is required. Returns invalid_oauth_token.

403.description: The account is not provisioned, employee access is disabled, or the channel does not match the current merchant. Returns account_not_provisioned or forbidden_error.

500.description: An unexpected error prevented authorization. Returns internal_server_error.

get.description: Returns the identity claims from the authenticated bearer token.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired. Returns invalid_oauth_token.

post.description: Creates a merchant and its first location, and makes the current account the business owner. If the account already owns a business, returns the existing merchant without changing its details. An account that belongs to a staff member cannot create a business. Requires a valid bearer token; existing merchant membership is not required.

200.description: Returns the merchant object for the new or existing business.

400.description: The request contains invalid JSON or one or more invalid values. Returns `validation_error`.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired. Returns invalid_oauth_token.

404.description: The account could not be found. Returns `resource_not_found`.

409.description: The account belongs to a staff member, or a conflicting change prevents the account from being updated. Returns `conflict_error`. Also returned for idempotency_key_mismatch or idempotency_request_in_progress when Idempotency-Key is supplied.

500.description: An unexpected error prevented the request from completing. Returns `internal_server_error`.

403.description: The account has no provisioned membership, or its employee is invited or disabled. Returns `account_not_provisioned` or `forbidden_error`.

post.description:
Creates a product with one default variant. Items start as drafts with zero stock at each location. Services start as active and do not track inventory.

Requires an enabled owner or staff account. See the request fields for pricing, identifiers, and collection requirements.

201.description: Returns the created product and its default variant. Items start as draft; services start as active.

400.description: The request contains invalid JSON or invalid field values, an item is missing unit_cost or has zero unit_cost, or an item's price is below its unit_cost. Returns validation_error or price_below_unit_cost, respectively.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired. Returns invalid_oauth_token.

403.description: The account has no provisioned membership (account_not_provisioned), or its employee is invited or disabled (forbidden_error).

404.description: The collection does not exist or does not belong to your merchant. Returns `resource_not_found`.

409.description: The SKU or barcode is already used within this merchant, including by archived products. Returns sku_already_exists or barcode_already_exists. Also returned for idempotency_key_mismatch or idempotency_request_in_progress when Idempotency-Key is supplied.

500.description: An unexpected error prevented the product from being created. Returns `internal_server_error`.

get.description:
Returns a page of purchases with line items, newest first by `created_at`, then by `id`. Includes all statuses unless you supply a status filter. Pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` with the same filters to retrieve the next page.

Enabled owners can read all purchases for their merchant. Enabled staff need `view_transactions` permission and can read purchases only at their assigned locations.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of purchases to return. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: Filter by location id. Unknown or inaccessible IDs return an empty page.

parameters.name: supplier_id
parameters.description: Filter by supplier id. Unknown or inaccessible IDs return an empty page.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at. ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit timezone. Either bound may be omitted; from must not exceed to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on created_at. ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit timezone. Either bound may be omitted; from must not exceed to.

200.description: Returns a page of purchases and pagination information.

400.description: Invalid filters, limit, cursor, timestamps, or reversed date range. Returns validation_error.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired. Returns `invalid_oauth_token`.

403.description: Membership is not provisioned, employee access is not enabled, or staff lack view_transactions permission. Returns account_not_provisioned or forbidden_error.

500.description: An unexpected error prevented the purchases from being listed. Returns `internal_server_error`.

get.description:
Returns a purchase with its supplier, creator, line item snapshots, notes, status, and timestamps.

Enabled owners can read all purchases for their merchant. Enabled staff need `view_transactions` permission and can read purchases only at their assigned locations.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The purchase identifier.

400.description: The request contains invalid JSON or values. Returns `validation_error`.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired. Returns `invalid_oauth_token`.

403.description: Membership is not provisioned, employee access is not enabled, or staff lack view_transactions permission. Returns account_not_provisioned or forbidden_error.

404.description: The purchase is missing, belongs to another merchant, or is at a location the staff member cannot access. Returns resource_not_found.

500.description: An unexpected error prevented the purchase from being retrieved. Returns `internal_server_error`.

post.description:
Creates a sale at a location and returns its line items, payments, and transaction number.

A fulfilled sale deducts stock for physical items. If any item has insufficient stock, the entire sale remains pending and no stock is deducted. Untracked stock counts as zero. Web sales require the location to allow backorders to accept a shortage. Android and iOS sales accept shortages as pending sales. Services do not affect stock.

Requires an enabled owner or staff account. Staff need `checkout` permission and access to the location. Reducing a line price or applying a discount also requires `apply_discounts` permission. The combined discount on each line must stay within the employee's `maxDiscountRate`. Owners are exempt from this cap. Final prices must not fall below unit cost.

Payments must exactly match the sale total. Tax is not applied. Discounted line totals and US-dollar payments converted at the location exchange rate are rounded to the nearest cent, with half cents rounded up, before summing. An exchange rate of zero gives US-dollar payments a local-currency value of zero.

201.description: The saved fulfilled or pending sale.

400.description: Invalid fields, duplicate variants, inactive catalog entries, a final price below cost, or payment mismatch. Returns validation_error, price_below_unit_cost, or payment_insufficient.

401.description: Missing or invalid bearer token.

403.description: Membership, checkout permission, location access, discount permission or discount cap prevents checkout.

404.description: Location, variant or optional customer is not found within this merchant.

409.description: Insufficient web stock with backorders disabled or exhausted location numbering. Returns stock_insufficient or conflict_error. Also returned for idempotency_key_mismatch or idempotency_request_in_progress when Idempotency-Key is supplied.

500.description: An unexpected error prevented the sale from being created. No sale or stock changes are applied.

parameters.name: location_id

parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on business_date. ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit timezone. Either bound may be omitted; from must not exceed to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on business_date. ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit timezone. Either bound may be omitted; from must not exceed to.

200.description: Returns a page of sales and pagination information.

400.description: Invalid filters, limit, cursor, timestamps, or reversed date range. Returns validation_error.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired. Returns `invalid_oauth_token`.

403.description: Membership is not provisioned, employee access is not enabled, or staff lack view_transactions permission. Returns account_not_provisioned or forbidden_error.

post.description:
Voids a fulfilled sale and restores its physical item quantities at the original location. You cannot void a sale if any physical product was restocked at or after the sale was created. Original payments remain in the sale history. Voiding does not issue a refund.

Enabled owners can void sales. Enabled staff need `void_sales` permission and access to the sale's location. Repeating the request returns the original void details without restoring stock again.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The sale identifier.

200.description: The voided sale, including its original payments and void metadata.

400.description: The reason is invalid, the sale is not fulfilled, or a product was restocked at or after the sale was created. Returns validation_error.

401.description: Missing or invalid bearer token.

403.description: Membership, void permission, employee status, or sale-location access prevents voiding.

404.description: The sale does not exist within this merchant.

409.description: Concurrent inventory changes prevented the void from completing. Returns concurrent_update_conflict. Also returned for idempotency_key_mismatch or idempotency_request_in_progress when Idempotency-Key is supplied.

500.description: An unexpected error prevented the sale from being voided. The sale and stock remain unchanged.

get.description:
Returns a sale with its line items, payments, customer, creator, and void details.

Enabled owners can read all sales for their merchant. Enabled staff need `view_transactions` permission and can read sales only at their assigned locations.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The sale identifier.

400.description: The request contains invalid JSON or values. Returns `validation_error`.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired. Returns `invalid_oauth_token`.

403.description: Membership is not provisioned, employee access is not enabled, or staff lack view_transactions permission. Returns account_not_provisioned or forbidden_error.

404.description: The sale is missing, belongs to another merchant, or is at a location the staff member cannot access. Returns resource_not_found.

500.description: An unexpected error prevented the sale from being retrieved. Returns `internal_server_error`.

facilito.changes.description: Published in staging and production after collection, customer, supplier, or product creation/update, purchase creation, sale creation, and sale voiding. Successful updates publish even when values are unchanged. Only the primary resource is published; publishing does not delay or fail the HTTP response.

RateLimitExceeded.description: Too many requests. Wait for the duration in the Retry-After header before trying again. Returns `rate_limit_exceeded`.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed during the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the current rate limit window resets.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

IdempotencyConflict.description: The key was used for a different request, returning `idempotency_key_mismatch`, or the original request has not returned a repeatable response, returning `idempotency_request_in_progress`. This retry does not execute the operation. Check whether the original operation succeeded before submitting a new request with a different key.

IdempotencyUnavailable.description: Idempotent requests are temporarily unavailable. This request does not execute the operation. Retry with the same key.

socket_id.description: The socket ID returned by Pusher.

channel_name.description: Exactly private-{merchantId} for the current merchant.

auth.description: Pusher application key followed by the HMAC-SHA256 subscription signature.

RealtimeChangeEvent.description: The facilito.changes event on private-{merchantId}. Emitted after a successful mutation of the primary resource. Delivery is best effort and unordered. Snapshots use the public API representation with snake_case keys. A serialized event of 10240 bytes or more has a null snapshot; resource_id is always included.

resource_id.description: Identifier of the resource that changed, including when snapshot is null.

AccountType.description: The role of an account within Facilito. Identifies a merchant owner, a staff member, or an internal account.

code.description: A stable code that identifies the failure. Use this value for programmatic error handling. See the operation responses for possible errors.

message.description: A human-readable explanation of the failure. Use `code`, rather than the message wording, to identify the error.
examples: Not enough stock for East Blue Tangerines at Water 7.

code.description: The code that identifies this individual issue.

message.description: A human-readable explanation of this individual issue.

field.description: The field associated with the issue, expressed as a dot-separated path that can include array indices. Omitted when the issue is not associated with a field.

details.description: The individual validation or business-rule issues associated with the failure. An empty array indicates that no further details are available.

BusinessError.description: An error with a stable `code`, a human-readable `message`, and individual issues in `details`. API error responses also include HTTP status and request information in `FacilitoError`.

examples.message: Not enough stock for East Blue Tangerines at Water 7.

BusinessType.description: The kind of business operated at a location, such as a restaurant, grocery store, or pharmacy.

id.description: The account identifier assigned by the identity provider.

name.description: The display name of the account.

email.description: The email address of the account. Returns `null` if none is recorded.

pictureUrl.description: The URL of the account profile image.

publicMetadata.description: The merchant, employee, and account-role information associated with the account. Each field is optional.

ClerkAccount.description: A sign-in account with its profile and optional merchant, employee, and account-role metadata.

name.description: The display name of the collection.

slug.description: The URL-friendly name of the collection.

created_at.description: The date and time when the collection was created, in RFC 3339 format.

updated_at.description: The date and time when the collection was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.

Collection.description: A group of related products in a merchant catalog. Use collections to organize products into categories, such as provisions or clothing. A product includes the identifier and name of its associated collection.

CountryIsoCode.description: A supported country code in lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format. The value `zz` represents an unspecified country.

CurrencyCode.description: A supported currency code in lowercase ISO 4217 format. The value `xxx` represents an unspecified currency.

id.description: The identifier of the authenticated account.

email.description: The email address of the authenticated account.

merchantId.description: The identifier of the merchant associated with the authenticated account.

employeeId.description: The identifier of the employee profile associated with the authenticated account.

accountType.description: The role of the authenticated account within Facilito.

CurrentUser.description: The authenticated account and its business context. Links the account to a merchant and an employee profile, and identifies its account role.

name.description: The display name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer. Returns `null` if none is recorded.

phone.description: The contact phone number of the customer. Returns `null` if none is recorded.

created_at.description: The date and time when the customer was created, in RFC 3339 format.

updated_at.description: The date and time when the customer was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.

Customer.description: A person or business that purchases from a merchant. Contains the customer name and contact details. Associate a customer with a sale to identify who made a purchase.

Decimal.description: A nonnegative decimal string with up to two fractional digits. Zero is allowed.

PositiveDecimal.description: A decimal value greater than zero, represented as a string with up to two fractional digits. Uses the same format as `Decimal`, but excludes zero.

name.description: The display name of the employee.

isOwner.description: Whether the employee is the owner of the merchant.

posAccessStatus.description: The access state of the employee at the point of sale: invited, enabled, or disabled.

permissions.description: The distinct point-of-sale capabilities assigned to the employee.

id.description: The identifier of the linked account.

email.description: The email address of the linked account.

account.description: The sign-in account linked to the employee. Returns `null` if no account is linked.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the employee was created, in RFC 3339 format.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the employee was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.

maxDiscountRate.description: Maximum effective line discount as a fraction. 0.10 means 10%. Defaults to 0.00. Owners are exempt.

Employee.description: A staff member associated with a merchant. Describes their ownership status, point-of-sale access, permissions, and linked sign-in account. Sales, purchase orders, and stock records reference employees to identify who recorded an operation.

code.description: A stable code that identifies the failure. Use this value for programmatic error handling.

message.description: A human-readable explanation of the failure. Use `code`, rather than the message wording, to identify the error.
examples: Not enough stock for East Blue Tangerines at Water 7.

code.description: The code that identifies this individual issue.

message.description: A human-readable explanation of this individual issue.

field.description: The field associated with the issue, expressed as a dot-separated path that can include array indices. Omitted when the issue is not associated with a field.

details.description: The individual validation or business-rule issues associated with the failure. An empty array indicates that no further details are available.

request_id.description: The identifier of the request associated with the error. Use this value when investigating a failed request.

status.description: The HTTP status code associated with the error.

FacilitoError.description: An error associated with an API request. Contains the HTTP status, request identifier, and business error details. Use `code` to handle the failure in your application and `request_id` to identify the request when investigating it.

examples.message: Not enough stock for East Blue Tangerines at Water 7.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
A unique key that lets you retry a POST request without repeating the operation. Use a UUID v4 or another opaque string of up to 255 characters. Keys belong to the authenticated user across all POST endpoints. Avoid sensitive information in keys.

Retries still require valid authentication, sufficient permissions, and compliance with rate limits. Reuse the key with the same URL path, query values, and JSON body to receive the original status and response, including errors other than `validation_error`. Preserve JSON field order, array order, repeated query value order, and value types. JSON whitespace and query parameter name order can change. A different request returns `idempotency_key_mismatch`. You can correct a request that returns `validation_error` and retry with the same key.

Keys expire 24 hours after the first valid request, even if you retry. An unfinished request can return `idempotency_request_in_progress` until expiry. Verify its outcome before using a new key. Reusing an expired key can execute the operation again.
